name: WebQA: Multimodal and Multihop Question Answering
description: WebQA is a large-scale multimodal and multi-hop question answering benchmark designed to simulate real-world web search query answering. It comprises 46,765 questions that require retrieving and jointly reasoning over text snippets and visual images from a knowledge base of 1.15 million text passages and 400,000 images, requiring full-sentence natural language answers rather than extractive spans.
